summary.description: Confirm that these merchant-provided details are correct before Calinium creates a Merchant Profile.
summary.confirmation_description: This confirms your interview summary. Calinium will generate a Merchant Profile only; it will not generate a strategy or change your Shopify theme.

completion.title: Your Merchant Profile is ready
completion.description: Your confirmed profile is ready for the next approved Calinium workflow. No storefront strategy has been generated.

cancel.title: Cancel this interview?
cancel.description: Cancelling marks this local interview session as abandoned. It cannot be resumed.

validation.step_incomplete: Complete the required answers in this step before continuing.
validation.summary_incomplete: Complete all required interview answers before reviewing your summary.

auth.create_description: Start a secure, private home for every brand you build with Calinium.
auth.sign_in_description: Sign in to continue with your projects and saved work.

home.title: Good to see you, {name}
home.description: Every project keeps its interview, Merchant Profile, and future storefront work together.
home.empty_projects: Create the first project for this workspace.
home.empty_activity: Your workspace activity will appear here.
home.empty_interviews: Start an interview from a project to see it here.
home.empty_profiles: Confirmed Merchant Profiles will appear here.

project_form.title: Begin with the brand
project_form.description: A project is the durable home for one business, its interview, Merchant Profile, and future approved work.
project_form.name: Project name

project.design_description: Continue the Creative Director conversation and review your storefront direction.
project.profile_pending: Complete the interview to create a Merchant Profile.
project.assets_placeholder: Brand assets will be collected in the next approved phase.
project.assets_description: Upload and manage the approved source assets for this project.
project.locked_description: This workflow is intentionally unavailable in the current phase.

settings.title: Account and workspace
settings.description: Manage the identity and preferences used by this Calinium workspace.
settings.security_description: Email and password sign-in is active. Additional sign-in methods will be added through the authentication provider boundary.
settings.shopify_description: Shopify connection is intentionally unavailable in this phase.

activity.storefront_generation_blocked: Storefront generation is waiting for resources
activity.shopify_connection_assigned: Shopify store added to this project
activity.shopify_project_bound: Project connected to this Shopify store

assets.title: Asset Library
assets.description: Secure, project-scoped source files for this merchant. Files remain private to this workspace.
assets.logo_upload_hint: PNG, JPEG, and WebP files are accepted. SVG files are intentionally not accepted.
assets.referenced_by_profile: Referenced by a confirmed Merchant Profile
assets.shopify_files_description: These are real files discovered from the connected store. Categorize and approve only the files Calinium may use.
assets.shopify_file_unavailable: This file is no longer available from Shopify.
assets.approval_saved: This Shopify file is approved for the Resource Plan.
assets.rejection_saved: This Shopify file will not be used.
assets.review_before_use: Categorize and approve this file before Calinium can use it.
assets.empty: No assets match this filter yet.
assets.delete_description: This removes the stored file and marks its asset record as deleted.
assets.delete_profile_warning: A confirmed Merchant Profile references this asset. Removing it preserves the profile trace but makes the file unavailable. Continue only if that is intended.
assets.removed_with_profile_warning: The asset was removed. A confirmed profile still records its historical reference.

colors.extraction_note: Suggestions are generated locally from a supported PNG logo. Select one to approve it; nothing is applied automatically.
colors.logo_required: Upload and select a PNG logo before extracting colours.

profile_view.description: A merchant-friendly record of confirmed business and brand context. Strategy generation remains unavailable in this phase.

landing.title: A storefront designed around your business.
landing.description: Tell Calinium what makes your business distinct. We’ll recommend a considered storefront direction for you to review.
landing.themes_description: Calinium One is available as a premium Shopify theme while the tailored storefront journey is being prepared.

common.calinium_will_recommend: Calinium will recommend this after learning a little more.

conversation.title: Let’s begin with your business.
conversation.description: One question at a time. You can pause whenever you need to.

understanding.title: Here’s what I understood.
understanding.description: Review the essentials before Calinium prepares your Brand Blueprint.
understanding.ready: This is enough context for Calinium to prepare a useful Brand Blueprint.
understanding.missing: A few essential details are still needed before Calinium can prepare a useful Brand Blueprint.

blueprint.title: A considered picture of your business.
blueprint.description: This is Calinium’s working understanding—not a final decision. Edit anything that does not feel right.
blueprint.confidence_value: {value}% of the critical business context is confirmed.
blueprint.approval_body: Approve the Brand Blueprint and Calinium will recommend the best storefront direction for your business.

strategy.title: A storefront direction designed for your business.
strategy.description: These are recommendations. Keep what feels right and ask Calinium to revisit what does not.
strategy.revision_label: What would you like to change?
strategy.approval_body: Once you approve this Store Strategy, Calinium will ask only for the real resources it needs. No storefront is generated yet.

resources.title: Choose the real materials Calinium can use.
resources.description: Calinium only works with resources you approve. Nothing is invented or pulled from your Shopify store automatically.
resources.strategy_reconciled: Your approved Store Strategy changed what Calinium needs. Please review these choices and save again before continuing.
resources.validation_summary: Calinium still needs the following approved resources:

shopify.title: Connect your Shopify store
shopify.description: Connect a store only when you are ready to review the specific catalog and theme resources Calinium may use.
shopify.connect_description: Calinium will ask Shopify only for the catalog, navigation, files, markets, and theme information needed to prepare your storefront. You choose what Calinium may use.
shopify.not_synced: Resources have not been refreshed yet.
shopify.missing_permissions: This connection needs additional Shopify permission before it can be used.
shopify.sync_before_approval: Refresh this Shopify store before reviewing what Calinium can use.
shopify.empty_resources: Shopify did not return any resources to review yet.
shopify.review_description: Approve only the products, collections, navigation, media, and preview target that belong in this storefront.
shopify.no_resource_counts: No Shopify resources are available yet.

assets.title: Your brand assets
assets.description: Upload or review the images, video, and documents Calinium may use.

resources.request_count: Needed across {count} parts of your storefront.
resources.approval_note: Saving confirms only the resources you have chosen. Calinium will keep anything else unresolved.
resources.asset_needed: Calinium needs an approved asset before this storefront can be prepared.

kind_help.product: Connect and approve products before selecting them.
kind_help.collection: Connect and approve collections before selecting them.
kind_help.menu: Connect and approve navigation before selecting it.
kind_help.content: This content remains available for review when a supported source is connected.
kind_help.confirmation: Calinium will keep this decision for the next review.

generation.title: Preparing your storefront.
generation.description: Calinium only reports work that has actually completed. You can return to resources at any time.

offer.title: Review your custom theme.
offer.description: This package is based only on the direction and resources you approved.
offer.price_note: Payment is required before package generation begins.
offer.output_default: A validated Shopify theme ZIP for manual installation.
offer.needs_attention: A few items need your attention
offer.confirm_staging_validation: Authorize staging generation — no Shopify charge
offer.staging_no_charge: LEGACY_EXAMPLE staging validation — no Shopify charge
offer.awaiting_shopify_approval: Awaiting your approval in Shopify. Calinium will verify payment before preparing anything.
offer.payment_unavailable: Payment is not available in this environment yet.
offer.notice: Calinium will prepare a downloadable storefront package. It will not modify or publish your Shopify theme automatically.

delivery.title: Your custom storefront is ready.
delivery.description: Download the validated package when you are ready to install it in Shopify.
delivery.validation_passed: The package completed Calinium’s configured validation checks.
delivery.validation_needs_attention: The package needs attention before it can be installed.
delivery.not_ready: This package is not ready to download yet.
delivery.install_step_two: In Shopify, add the ZIP as a new unpublished theme.
delivery.install_step_three: Review the theme before choosing whether to publish it.
delivery.notice: Calinium has not modified or published your Shopify theme. Download and install the generated package when you are ready.

preview.title: Your storefront is ready for review.
preview.description: Review the generated storefront package before any deployment can begin.
preview.note: A live Shopify preview becomes available only after the separate, approved development-theme deployment workflow. Nothing has been deployed from this dashboard.
preview.shopify_unavailable: A Shopify preview is not available yet. Calinium has not changed your live store.

view_descriptions.homepage: The first impression and storytelling flow.

view_descriptions.cart: A calm final review before purchase.

view_descriptions.footer: Essential information and useful next steps.

finish.title: Your storefront direction is ready.
finish.description: The generated package is ready for Calinium’s separate review workflow. Deployment remains blocked until that approval process is complete.

shopify_live.sync_needs_attention: The last refresh needs attention. You can try again when Shopify is available.
